Strategy: Combine the gated gentle fifteen sweet band with a shifted mid penalty of fifteen over residuals ten to twenty-five, plus an exact-fit bonus. This stacks three preferences that each helped alone, but the penalty shift is a guess and may punish usable residuals.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (15 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 10 and r - item <= 25 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
